notes: DiscoFlate v3.30.0 — Templates: save Ends/End Sequences, Polls, Competitions & Capacity Events as templates (new Templates sections). Gameplay presets/export now include Bonus Rounds (were being dropped). Discord tab: set the bot's profile picture (avatar). Camera: much higher capture quality — always requests a high resolution (dropdown-picked cameras used to fall back to ~640×480), defaults to the rear camera, and captures at native resolution instead of a hard 720×1280 cap.
